title: Moto oyo azali koloba na mongongo ya nse na wolo na esobe
intro: Kanisá kaa moko monene ya esobe na mwa ntango ya kozela mpe ya kozanga koyeba. Mokambi monene akei mosika mpo na bokutani na Bonzambe, kotikaka nsima lisanga moko oyo ezali na mposa makasi ya eloko moko ya kosimba mpo na kosimba. Na bopemi wana ya kozanga kimia, moto moko ya kondimisa azali kokende liboso na bilaka ya kongenga mpe ekelamu ya mayele oyo emonani lokola ezali na bomoi.
clues: Nazalaki kati na baoyo balongwaki na Ezipito elongo na Musa, kotatolaka mbu ekabwanaki mpo na kokima biso.
Natalaki ntango mokambi na biso akendaki na ngomba mpo na butu ntuku minei mpo na kozwa bokambi.
Nazalaki kosangisa biloko ya kokembisa epai ya bato mpe nazalaki kobongisa yango na mabɔkɔ na ngai moko.
Nasalaki mwana ya ngɔmbɛ oyo ezalaki kobimisa mongongo ya koganga, mpe nabengaki bato báya na yango.
Nazwaki mwa mputulu na nzela ya motindami mpe nabwakaki yango na oyo nasalaki.
Nakutanaki na Musa mpe na condamner koloba ‘kosimba ngai te’ mpe kofanda mosika, na bokutani oyo balakaki mpo na kosambisa.

arabic: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
verse: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it [i.e., its ashes] into the sea with a blast. (20:97)
